name: strike-screen-market-requests
notes: ADR-0270 section 5, market reference stage, document 1 of 2: one exact-expiry market request per M24 panel origin. ZERO fits. Holdout lock: every reader carries end_before 2021-01-01 and the Theta reader also sealed_from 2026-01-01 (2026 sealed forever). Spot is Theta underlying_price, the UNADJUSTED basis the strikes share; the panel's split-adjusted spot is not stored and is not used. Identities are restricted HERE to origins whose settlement_date equals a listed expiration on the quote date (the Friday-settlement subset; outcome independent), so the quotes document only has to keep the quotes of these identities. A quote date without a same-day DGS3MO print is a counted exclusion (join inner; the census is the join's matched output), never a filled value. BLOCKED (gap G1): DGS3MO is percent TEXT in the pinned rates artifact and ComputeFields treats a text operand as null_input, so growth is null on every row; OptionPriceProxy refuses a non-positive or null growth, so the chain fails closed at the proxy. Do not onboard requests.jsonl for the proxy until a numeric parse exists (proposal: a ComputeFields op that parses numeric text, '.' as null_input). Output is newline-JSON (records-write is the only row writer; there is no Parquet writer kind, gap G2). MEMORY: the chain reader is lazy, but calc is the only kind that accepts it and materializes the projected M24 chain (Stage 0: 9,935,330 rows); measured 0.73 GiB peak on AAPL+ALB (1,120,963 rows) projects to about 6.5 GiB, under the ADR-0270 8 GiB cap but above a 6 GiB guard: measure the first run. Run from the worktree root: python -m dskit.pipeline run children/index_options/configs/run-strike-screen-market-requests.json --asof 2020-12-31.

outputs.notes: Inside the pilot root; nothing is written under /home/russell/data/thetadata or any R5/R6 root.

panel.notes: The onboarded fit panel (member panel.parquet sha256 bf110d49...b2b28961), projected to the request identity, scale and calendar DTE; no outcome column is read. Quote dates 2019-01-01..2020-12-31 (the panel ends 2020-11-30), settlement before 2021-01-01. symbol in M24 is registration/cohorts.json key m24, pinned equal by the child test.

panel_basis.notes: attach-by-identity requires a non-empty agree_fields list and the panel shares no natural column with the chain; both sides therefore declare the price basis they are on, and the attach refuses a row whose declarations differ.

chain.notes: The frozen Theta export, read-only, M24 roots only (isin pushed into the scan), four projected columns. A file whose footer window reaches 2026-01-01 refuses whole. The tree's file plan is pinned by the node fingerprint at run time.

chain_rows.notes: Renames the chain's date and expiration to the request identity names (ISO text both sides). This is the only kind that accepts the lazy chain source; it materializes the projected rows.

chain_priced.notes: groupby refuses a null under a numeric op; a contract row without a positive underlying_price carries no spot (Stage 0 probe: 198,067 such rows, one symbol-date with none at all, no symbol-date with two values).

spot_days.notes: One spot per (symbol, quote_date). spot_values counts the distinct underlying prices that day; a day with more than one is excluded below, never averaged.

spot_table.notes: The agree field, as in panel_basis.

listed_days.notes: The export's distinct (symbol, date, expiration) identities, with the contract-row count of each.

listed_table.notes: The agree field, as in panel_basis.

spot.clock_note: Theta end-of-day underlying_price of the quote date: known after that day's close, indicative, not executable

with_spot.notes: Spot onto every panel origin. max_absent_fraction 0.01 tolerates the rare chain day with no priced row (Stage 0: one symbol-date) and refuses anything larger as a wrong source; absences are counted in the summary and dropped below.

listed.clock_note: the listed expirations quoted on the quote date

with_listing.notes: Exact-expiry restriction: an origin whose settlement_date is not a listed expiration that day is absent here (Stage 0: 1,990 of 6,524 M24 origins listed). max_absent_fraction 1.0 because absence IS the restriction; the summary counts it.

census.notes: The counted exclusions by reason (kept in carry.json): spot absent, expiration not listed.

eligible.notes: Market-eligible identities only: one unambiguous spot and a listed exact expiration.

rates.notes: ALFRED DGS3MO vintage 2025-12-31 (member rates.parquet sha256 d6301665...4137f5711), percent as TEXT, '.' on a holiday (dropped here: a '.' is not a rate).

rate_by_date.notes: One print per observation date; a repeated date refuses.

with_rate.notes: SAME-DAY rate (ADR-0270: an as-of join is not a flow kind). An origin with no same-day print is dropped and counted in the join's matched output (Stage 0: none among the 1,990 eligible).

requests.notes: growth = exp(DGS3MO/100 * actual_calendar_dte/365) (BLOCKED, gap G1: dgs3mo is text, so growth is null and counted as null_input in the summary). available_at = decision_at = quote_date under the declared clock. decision_strike_z = 0.0 is the ADR-0270 pilot decision strike (ATM standardized), a constant column so every downstream market record carries it. expiry stays the panel expiry (quote_date + 31) because the proxy, the paired scores and the pockets join on (symbol, quote_date, expiry); settlement_date is the listed expiration.

params.source: ADR-0270 market requests: M24 exact-expiry identities with Theta unadjusted spot, panel reference scale, same-day DGS3MO growth and quote-date clocks

write.notes: Canonical newline-JSON; the directory holds only this file so a localfiles source over it has one stream, requests.
